symbols.name: Game_FrameUpdate
symbols.evidence: polls input once per frame (pushes [006B38E4], 1; calls 001F6C00 at 00048FF4) and is on the host call chain of every write to the scene camera (data watch on the camera yaw: sub_000EDF20 < sub_000F0500 < sub_000490B0 < sub_00048FE0)

symbols.name: Camera_BuildViews
symbols.evidence: builds a camera struct on the stack and copies it (000EDF20 at 000F0C6E) into this+0x1468+index*0x63C, the per-view camera array the renderer reads; data watch on a view's yaw names it

symbols.name: Camera_Copy
symbols.evidence: register-passed copy (ecx source, eax destination) of the 0x63C-byte camera struct, one dword at a time; called by 000F0500, 000EDDF0, 0045E8B0

symbols.name: Input_PollPads
symbols.evidence: stdcall (InputManager*, flag), ret 8: for each of 4 ports with an open handle (this+0x248+4i) copies the last state (0x16 bytes), calls XInputGetState (005C5988) at 001F6DE4, then 001F7480 for the left (ebx 0) and right (ebx 1) stick; callers 00048FE0 and 00220200 pass [006B38E4]

symbols.name: Input_ProcessStick
symbols.evidence: called twice per port by 001F6C00 (ebx 0 left, 1 right; ecx port) with pointers to the stick's X and Y floats in the InputManager
symbols.notes: presumably dead zone and scaling to -1..1; confirm by a probe on its outputs

symbols.name: Controls_Update
symbols.evidence: thiscall (Controls*, int frame time) from 000F0683 with ecx = [view+0x74C]: picks the slot this+0xC+port*0x2C ([this+0xBC] port), stores the pad index and the time, tail-jumps to 001FA480 with the slot's ActionMap ([slot+4])

symbols.name: ActionMap_Dispatch
symbols.evidence: for each binding in the lists at this+0x18 and [this+0x44]+0x18 reads the control with 001F82A0, queues (action id [node+0xC], value) with 001FA9A0, then calls the listener's first virtual ([[controls+0x14+port*0x2C]]) as (id, value, extra) for each queued event; the right stick's only readers besides Input_ProcessStick are this path (data watch, 2026-10-15)

symbols.name: ActionMap_ReadControl
symbols.evidence: control codes 0x15000000..0x18000000 read InputManager leftX/leftY/rightX/rightY[pad] (+0x1EC/+0x1FC/+0x20C/+0x21C); rightY is multiplied by [0062A6E0] unless the invert byte [controls+8] is set; returns 1 with the value through the last argument

symbols.name: ActionMap_IsControlActive
symbols.evidence: same control codes as 001F82A0 but returns only whether any port's control is non-zero (buttons through 001F73E0/001F7190)

symbols.name: GameView_OnAction
symbols.evidence: first entry of the game view's vtable (00604BD8, read from a live view); thiscall (id, value, extra), stamps this+0x2C with the time and forwards to 000EDB70 with eax = this

symbols.name: GameView_HandleAction
symbols.evidence: switch on action id - 5 (table at 000EDD70): analog actions store the value at view+0x618/+0x61C/+0x5DC/+0x5E0 (the last two are look X/Y and also raise input flags 7/8 in the block at view+0x60C via 00077200); button actions raise flags 0x0A..0x24

symbols.name: Look_Update
symbols.evidence: stdcall (&view->lookControl, lookX, lookY), edx = the view's input block: calls 0003D450 with [view+0x24]; called once per frame by Camera_BuildViews at 000F06A0 with [view+0x5DC], [view+0x5E0]

symbols.name: Look_ComputeTurn
symbols.evidence: the stick's look values to this frame's turn: keeps them only while input flags 7/8 are set, snaps the minor axis, clamps into block+0xC4/+0xC8, applies the target-dependent slowdown and rate, and writes the turn in degrees to block+0xBC (yaw) and +0xC0 (pitch); reads of those two fields: only 00098AE0 and 0008C840 (data watch)

symbols.name: Player_ProcessInput
symbols.evidence: thiscall (Player*, ViewInput*), ret 4, the controlled actor's virtual +0xD0, called by Camera_BuildViews at 000F08AE: delta = (block+0xC0, 0, -block+0xBC) added to the view angles block+0x18..+0x20 by 0009C610, which writes them back; adding mouse counts to +0xBC/+0xC0 in a prehook turns the view by exactly that many degrees (1000 counts at 0.05: -50.000 yaw; 7200: a full turn back to the same frame) (2026-10-15)

symbols.name: Player_ApplyTurn
symbols.evidence: register-passed (esi player, edi angles, ebx delta): angles += delta, each wrapped by 00023FE0; with player+0x400 / +0x401 set (mounted, ladders) the yaw/pitch go through limit helper 0009C8D0 instead; on foot the pitch ends clamped to +-85 (direct aim test)

symbols.name: Angle_Wrap180
symbols.evidence: cdecl (float degrees) -> xmm0; applied to every angle after a turn; a pitch pushed past -180 came back as +145 and was then clamped to +85 (direct aim test)

symbols.name: Movie_Play
symbols.evidence: cdecl (char *path, ...): plays a Bink movie to its end (polls input while it runs); the startup logos (001FD7F6, 001FD840) and the intro (00048F57) pass the path built by sprintf 004EAAFB; skipping it with a gate (tools/compile.py REPLACE, fci_gate_00220200) leaves the title going straight on to the next movie, then the title screen (2026-10-15)

symbols.name: Boot_PlayLogos
symbols.evidence: plays Videos\Ubisoft.bik and Videos\Crytek.bik through 00220200 (string pushes at 001FD7F6, 001FD840)

symbols.name: sprintf
symbols.evidence: CRT: (buffer, "%s%s" at 005F8CC0, directory, file) builds every movie path before 00220200

symbols.name: g_pInputManager
symbols.evidence: both callers of 001F6C00 pass this pointer as the InputManager (00048FE6, 00220368); data watch *006B38E4+20C resolved to the live object

symbols.name: vtbl_GameView
symbols.evidence: [view] of the live Camera_BuildViews argument (status "view", 2026-10-15): 000F67D0, 000EEC00, 000EF5B0, 002DF6F0, 000822E0

symbols.name: g_strDataRoot
symbols.evidence: std::string-like (inline buffer when [00644538] < 0x10, else a pointer): the folder prefix every movie path is built from

symbols.name: Console_CreateVariable
symbols.evidence: thiscall (ecx = console; name, default string, flags, help), 192 callers; the caller keeps the returned variable and reads it later (r_glow at 00058BB1, r_Width at 001FBEDB)

symbols.name: Console_RegisterFloat
symbols.evidence: eax = console; (name, float* storage, float default, flags, help), ret 0x14; finds the name in the console's map at +0x88 (001FF3A0) and returns the variable's value in xmm0, which the caller stores (e_obj_view_dist_ratio at 0048236C)

symbols.name: Console_RegisterInt
symbols.evidence: as Console_RegisterFloat with int* storage and the value returned in eax; the default is still a float (0x3F800000 for e_detail_objects at 00481B41)

symbols.name: Engine3D_RegisterCVars
symbols.evidence: registers the 3D engine's 80 e_* variables (e_detail_objects ... e_max_view_distance) into this+0xC..+0x104; called by 0045FA00

symbols.name: Video_Setup
symbols.evidence: fills the present parameters: 640x480 always; XGetVideoFlags 0x01 adds D3DPRESENTFLAG_WIDESCREEN (0x10) and a 16:9 pixel aspect at this+0x6AC; with RECOMP_FCI_ASPECT=16:9 CreateDevice logs flags 0x30 instead of 0x20 (2026-10-16)

symbols.name: XGetVideoFlags
symbols.evidence: XAPI: ExQueryNonVolatileSetting(XC_VIDEO = 8) >> 16 & 0x5F, HD modes cleared without the HDTV AV pack; its only caller is Video_Setup; a stored 0x00010000 makes the title widescreen

symbols.name: XGetVideoStandard
symbols.evidence: XAPI: byte 1 of ExQueryNonVolatileSetting(XC_FACTORY_AV_REGION = 0x103); Video_Setup compares it with 3 (PAL)

symbols.name: XGetAVPack
symbols.evidence: XAPI: returns the kernel data export at [005C6C38]; XGetVideoFlags keeps the HD modes only when it is 1

symbols.name: g_pConsole
symbols.evidence: loaded into eax or ecx as the console before every Console_Register* and Console_CreateVariable call

fields.name: lookY

fields.name: input

fields.name: controls
fields.evidence: ecx of Controls_Update at 000F0683; [controls+0x14+port*0x2C] is set to this view (000F0620)

ViewInput.evidence: the block at GameView+0x60C: filled by GameView_HandleAction and Look_ComputeTurn, consumed by Player_ProcessInput, cleared by Camera_BuildViews after the actor ran (000F08FE)

fields.name: angles
fields.evidence: Player_ProcessInput starts from them and writes the turned angles back (sets +0xB8); injected mouse counts move them by exactly counts * degrees; pitch grows looking down

fields.name: anglesChanged

fields.evidence: yaw -= it in Player_ProcessInput; positive turns right

fields.name: turnPitch
fields.evidence: pitch += it; positive looks down

fields.name: lookAxes
fields.evidence: the snapped and clamped stick look values (Look_ComputeTurn); read only by Camera_BuildViews
